why: Image 2 reads as a real room at night: warm practical light falls off naturally along the fluted bar, haze catches the beams, and the stools carry the eye in depth toward a speaker in the far corner. Image 1 is undone by its grey, featureless motion-blurred mannequin figures and its flatter, colder light, though Image 2's half-empty shelves and slightly waxy upholstery stop it from being a decisive win.
